# WO-169: CLI malformed-invocation contract tests
Status: open (bulk; Nora dispatches, WIP 5)
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (CLAUDE_TO_CODEX.md)
Assigned to: Codex channel session (Nora dispatches)
Source: CODEX-061 test-scout idea, accepted in CLAUDE-024

## Goal
A table-driven contract for malformed CLI invocations: unknown command, unknown option, missing required argument, bad value type, and `--json` with a usage error. Each must exit non-zero with a short plain message, never a Python traceback, and never print personal data from the store. Use the in-process Typer/Click runner only.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- First, list the existing CLI error tests you found (tests/test_cli*.py, tests/codex/test_cx_cli_json_contract.py) and skip any case they already cover; say which in VENDOR_STATUS.md.
- No traceback text ("Traceback (most recent call last)") in stdout or stderr for any case.
- Real product bugs found: strict xfail with src file:line in the reason; no src/ edits.
- No real personal data; examples use Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL. No store, keyring, mailbox or network use (isolate with tmp_path / monkeypatch).
- Create no files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/codex/test_cx_cli_malformed.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
src/, every existing file.
